a: Last-operation wrap of an ongoing handle splits `this`: onEnd/replay run on the original, every other method on a spread copy
An emptied yoke left as its parent's active child takes every read from the root
`rankedDepRegistry` loses its rank when a caller passes `{ rank: undefined }`
`checkEnabled` JSDoc names the wrong throw reason
b: The last-operation wrapper hands the dispatcher a spread copy of the gesture's handle, so a handle using `this` (or prototype methods/getters) splits its state
The last operation outlives the input scope it ran in, and adjusting it reruns against the parent scope's deps
A hold runs its action with the params resolved at the press, so a thunked binding param changed while the key is held is not what runs
`checkEnabled`'s doc names the wrong disabled reason for a throwing predicate
